# Kiraya — Direct Owner Rental Platform in Pune
> Kiraya is a tenant-first rental platform operating exclusively in Pune, India. It prioritizes listing truthfulness (100% itemized costs, zero hidden brokerage, physically verified availability) over raw listing volume.

## Platform Highlights
- Zero Brokerage: Direct owner connections with transparent, disclosed brokerage fees (₹0 for owner listings).
- Itemized Costs: Exact monthly rent, maintenance, security deposit, and move-in outlay displayed up front.
- Physical Verification: Listings carry fresh physical verification dates (`last_verified_at`) and verified photo timestamps.
- Single Locality Focus: Focused on Pune, covering over 50+ neighborhoods and micro-markets.

## Core Hubs & Catalogs
- [All Pune Listings](https://www.kirayah.xyz/listings) : Browse all live verified apartments in Pune
- [Direct Flatmates](https://www.kirayah.xyz/direct) : Direct roommate and replacement tenant postings
